# hubspot_properties (Data Source)

Lists every property defined on a CRM object type, including HubSpot-defined defaults. Archived properties are excluded unless `include_archived` is set. Filter the returned list with HCL expressions (e.g. `[for p in data.hubspot_properties.x.properties : p.name if !p.hubspot_defined]`). Requires the `crm.schemas.{objectType}.read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every property defined on the contacts object.
data "hubspot_properties" "contacts" {
  object_type = "contacts"
}

# Filter with HCL: the internal names of the custom (non-HubSpot-defined)
# properties only.
output "custom_contact_properties" {
  value = [
    for p in data.hubspot_properties.contacts.properties : p.name
    if !p.hubspot_defined
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_type` (String) CRM object type to list properties for (e.g. `contacts`, `deals`).

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) When `true`, returns archived properties **instead of** active ones (mirrors the HubSpot API's `archived` query parameter). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for the data source (the object type).
- `properties` (Attributes List) The properties defined on the object type, ordered by internal name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the property is archived.
- `calculated` (Boolean) Whether the property is calculated from a formula.
- `description` (String) Description of the property.
- `field_type` (String) UI field type (e.g. `text`, `select`, `checkbox`).
- `group_name` (String) Name of the property group the property belongs to.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the property is hidden in the HubSpot UI.
- `hubspot_defined` (Boolean) Whether the property is a HubSpot-defined default (not a custom property).
- `label` (String) Human-readable label shown in the HubSpot UI.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the property.
- `type` (String) Data type (`string`, `number`, `bool`, `enumeration`, `date`, `datetime`).
